# Cygenix

> AI-assisted SQL database migration platform. Maps schemas, forecasts row-level
> failures before a run, moves server-level objects (logins, SQL Agent jobs, SSIS
> projects, linked servers), and records every gated action in a hash-chained
> audit trail. Driven from the browser, but the database connections are opened by
> Cygenix: rows pass through the service during a run and are not stored there.
> Metadata is held in Azure Cosmos DB in UK South; the functions that open the
> connections are hosted on Netlify, which processes in the US.

Cygenix Ltd is a UK company (registered in England and Wales, no. 16063342).
It is run by Curtis Morris, who spent thirty years in data migration, eight of
them at Thomson Reuters Elite running conversions for law firms.

Two ways to use it: self-service subscription from £99/month with a 14-day
trial, or consultant-led delivery, which begins with a free schema assessment.

## Sources and targets
- Sources: SQL Server 2012+, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance (beta), PostgreSQL, CSV/Excel/delimited files, Azure Blob Storage
- Targets: SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance (beta), PostgreSQL

## Pages
- [Platform](https://cygenix.co.uk/): mapping, preflight, schema explorer, server objects, governance, automation, reporting

- [About](https://cygenix.co.uk/about): Curtis Morris, founder, and how consultant-led engagements work
